offering_codeReviewIa.name: AI code review
offering_codeReviewIa.tagline: Get automated comments on every PR with suggestions and bug detection
offering_codeReviewIa.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "AI code review". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with pull requests reviewed
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and pull requests reviewed

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of pull requests reviewed
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of pull requests reviewed
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_codeReviewIa.costoNote: LLM (~$80–$25,000 USD/mo) and enterprise SAST/SCA tools are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
